outboundAuthorization.title: Outbound authorization
outboundAuthorization.description: Who an unattended run may message, email, write to on GitHub or submit to in the browser without asking. Each kind starts in shadow mode, which only observes.
outboundAuthorization.remoteHost: This device is driving a paired Host, where the runs and their records are. Change this setting on the Host.
outboundAuthorization.noList: No list can hold this recipient
outboundAuthorization.unrecognized: {count, plural, one {# recipient} other {# recipients}} via {account} this device cannot name ({sends, plural, one {# send} other {# sends}}). Add them in the Bot's or the connection's settings.

confirm.impact: {count, plural, one {# observed send} other {# observed sends}} would have been changed:
confirm.noImpact: No observed send would have been changed.

messaging.label: Enforce for messages and email
messaging.shadowHelp: Off: every send is checked and recorded, and none is changed. Turn on to hold the sends nothing authorized.
messaging.enforceHelp: On: an unattended send to a recipient nobody allowed is drafted or waits for approval, and a recipient a person refused stays refused for that request.
messaging.reportDescription: Sends observed in the last {days} days whose recipient nothing allowed. Allow the ones you meant before turning enforcement on.
messaging.reportEmpty: Nothing would change: every observed send had a recipient someone allowed.
messaging.confirmTitle: Enforce outbound authorization for messages and email?
messaging.confirmBehaviour: Unattended sends to a recipient nobody allowed will be drafted or wait for approval instead of going out, and a person's refusal holds for the rest of that request.

github.label: Enforce for GitHub writes
github.shadowHelp: Off: every GitHub write by a run, a workflow, a plugin, a Bot or a gh command is checked and recorded, and none is changed. This is separate from messages and email.
github.enforceHelp: On: an unattended write to a repository nobody allowed waits for approval, a chat's write to a repository other than the one it came from asks, and a repository a person refused stays refused for that request.
github.reportDescription: GitHub writes observed in the last {days} days to a repository nothing allowed. Writes you made yourself are not listed. Allow the repositories you meant before turning enforcement on.
github.reportEmpty: Nothing would change: every observed GitHub write went to a repository someone allowed.
github.confirmTitle: Enforce outbound authorization for GitHub writes?
github.confirmBehaviour: Unattended writes to a repository nobody allowed will wait for approval instead of going out, writes from a chat to another repository will ask, and a person's refusal holds for the rest of that request. Messages and email keep their own setting.

browser.label: Enforce for browser submissions
browser.shadowHelp: Off: every submission an agent's browser actions make (a form, a sign-up, a post) is checked and recorded, and none is changed. This is separate from messages, email and GitHub.
browser.enforceHelp: On: a submission to a site nobody listed asks the person at this computer, or waits for approval when nobody is watching; a site a person refused stays refused for that request. The action waits for the answer.
browser.reportDescription: Browser submissions observed in the last {days} days to a site nothing allowed. Allow the sites you meant before turning enforcement on.
browser.reportEmpty: Nothing would change: every observed browser submission went to a site someone allowed.
browser.confirmTitle: Enforce outbound authorization for browser submissions?
browser.confirmBehaviour: Submissions to a site nobody listed will ask or wait for approval instead of going out, and a person's refusal holds for the rest of that request. Messages, email and GitHub keep their own settings.
browser.limits: Not checked: data a page sends in its address (a search, a GET form), autosave while typing, and connections a page's background workers open. In the built-in preview and the extension browser, a click, a selection or Enter that might submit is checked before it runs.

outboundAuthorization.chooseAccount: The write named no account. Add to:
outboundAuthorization.unrecognizedRepositories: {count, plural, one {# repository} other {# repositories}} this device cannot name ({sends, plural, one {# write} other {# writes}}). Add them to a GitHub account's list in Integrations.
outboundAuthorization.unrecognizedSites: {count, plural, one {# site} other {# sites}} this device cannot name ({sends, plural, one {# submission} other {# submissions}}). Add them to the site list below.

sites.title: Sites browser submissions may reach
sites.description: An agent's browser submission (a form, a sign-up, a post) to one of these sites, from a chat, a scheduled task or a workflow, will go ahead without asking. A Bot's own list can hold sites for that Bot alone. A typed address is listed as its whole site.
